triggers.name: trg_whatsapp_invoice_evidence_v17
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_whatsapp_invoice_evidence_v17 AFTER UPDATE OF invoice_match_status, matched_invoice_id, matched_invoice_number, matched_invoice_value, matched_invoice_date, invoice_match_confidence ON public.whatsapp_review_sources FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.invoice_match_status IS DISTINCT FROM new.invoice_match_status) OR (old.matched_invoice_id IS DISTINCT FROM new.matched_invoice_id) OR (old.matched_invoice_number IS DISTINCT FROM new.matched_invoice_number) OR (old.matched_invoice_value IS DISTINCT FROM new.matched_invoice_value) OR (old.matched_invoice_date IS DISTINCT FROM new.matched_invoice_date) OR (old.invoice_match_confidence IS DISTINCT FROM new.invoice_match_confidence))) EXECUTE FUNCTION dawaa_sync_whatsapp_invoice_evidence_v17()
